run_random_agent: run a random agent against a DM Lab2D environment with configurable level, seed, and episode count
create_environment: create a DM Lab2D environment with a specified level name, observation type, and environment seed
build_random_agent: build a PyGameRandomAgent instance with action specs, observation specs, seed, and display scale
test_agent_step: test the agent step method to render observations and return random actions for each timestep
summarize_agent_stats: summarize agent statistics by printing accumulated scores across all completed episodes
